summary: Body of a 60-year-old man found after an apparent ~300-ft fall late Monday afternoon in a scree/loose-rock gully (park location not specified); appeared he jumped to his death; recovery required a technical raise of about 300 ft; 16 park staff involved
location: Rocky Mountain National Park (gully, location unspecified)
notes: Incident date pinned to Mon 2011-08-15: report filed Wed Aug 17 says the fall was "late on Monday afternoon"; weekday-verified. County left blank — report names no location within the park.
